The successful candidate will engage with executive leadership, engineering teams, programme directors, and technical decision-makers throughout the project lifecycle, positioning CTS as the preferred engineering and delivery partner for data centre be they colocation, cloud service or AI factories. Engage regularly with consultants, engineering practices, developers, investors, contractors, and infrastructure stakeholders to strengthen CTS’s market presence. Build relationships based upon technical excellence, delivery capability, and long-term strategic value rather than transactional opportunities. Utilize personal and CTS group knowledge and engineering excellence to identify and successfully drive data centre project business to CTS. Take both an account based and a territory based approach to opportunity identification, development and execution. Demonstrate the advantages of CTS’s integrated delivery model, including accelerated design programmes, superior engineering standards, reduced project risk, modularisation, and factory-based delivery. Develop relationships with key market influencers including consultants, OEMs, technology providers, utility companies, developers, and industry organisations. Hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, AI, or cloud infrastructure. Key Performance Indicators Development of strategic client relationships across key European markets. As an ERP Support Engineer, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, ensuring seamless installations, upgrades, and configurations of QAD products. You will leverage your expertise to perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backups, and troubleshooting.
